entries.title: Forsakenween 2026 balance changes
items: Updated 1x1x1x1's walk and sprint speed, Mass Infection, Entanglement, Unstable Eye and Rejuvenate the Rotten.
Updated Elliot's Pizza Throw and Rush Hour, and added the two new Rush Hour rewards.
Updated Noob's Bloxy Cola, Slateskin Potion and Ghostburger.
Updated Helperbot's Inspire and Pulse.
Updated Two Time's Crouch and the Crouch backstab stun.
Exhausted now lowers stamina by 5% per level instead of 10%.

entries.title: New ability videos
items: Added videos for Guest 666's Blood Hunt and Eviscerate, Noli's Observant, and Azure's Inflorescence and Blooming.
New recordings for John Doe's Retract and Azure's Unearthing.

entries.title: Two Time techs
items: Added Matador Backstab, Slide Backstab and Sixer Eviscerate Stab.

entries.title: TierLists & Maps
items: 1x1x1x1 moved from C to A on Brandon6875935's Place.

entries.title: Character pages
items: Removed the background and source line at the bottom of each character page.

entries.title: Skin themes
items: Annihilation John Doe and Timeless 1x1x1x1 now have all three terror radius layers, their chase theme and their LMS.
Friend Elliot's LMS now shows its name, CLOSE TO ME.

entries.title: Every released skin
items: Added 358 skins, for 1,048 in total.
Added a purple Special group for skins from events, packs and achievements.
Skins show their title art in the skin preview.

entries.title: Ability videos
items: Added gameplay videos to Killer abilities. They play muted while their ability is open.

entries.title: Strategies & Techs
items: Added new Killer techs.
The General tab is now split into All Survivors and All Killers.

entries.title: Ability text
items: Removed old event versions and outdated values from ability descriptions.

entries.title: TierLists & Maps
items: New Killer rankings on several maps.
Added Yorick's Resting Place.
Added map buttons that jump to each map.

entries.title: Meta Comps
items: Added the best Survivor team to bring against each Killer, with tips on how to play it.

entries.title: Strategies & Techs
items: Added a Strategies & Techs section to every Killer and Survivor.

entries.title: Forsaken coverage release!
items: Added the Forsaken page.
Added The Forsaken, with every Survivor and Killer.
Added TierLists & Maps.
Added Items on Survivor pages.
